name: NarrativeQA
description: NarrativeQA is a reading comprehension dataset where questions are answered based on full-length books and movie scripts. Questions and answers were written by humans who only had access to a short summary of the document, ensuring answers cannot be extracted by simple span selection and require genuine narrative understanding.
reputation: Challenging long-document reading comprehension benchmark; published at TACL 2018; requires understanding full books; abstractive answers prevent simple span extraction
notes: Published at TACL 2018. Documents are full books (from Project Gutenberg) and movie scripts (~1,500 total documents). Questions were written based only on Wikipedia summaries of the books. Two settings: full-document (complete book) and summary (Wikipedia summary only). Part of SCROLLS benchmark. Tests deep narrative comprehension across very long documents.
